comingLast.roast: 6 holes for a jailbreak - 4 points cuts the wire
sitting 3 above Todd and driving very, very carefully
3 from the double blue - a wipe here would be extremely on-brand
5 points of breathing room at 1.3 a hole - shallow breaths
6 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
6 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
a 7-point moat between him and Todd's crown - shallow moat
the buffer reads 8 - his group reads it aloud each tee
his 10-point buffer is doing a lot of heavy lifting
one quiet stretch from joining Todd in the conversation nobody wants
